conversation.content: I need to move my business booking BK-1000 to June 24, but I do not want you to change anything until you compare at least two same-day business options and show me the exact extra amount for each.

**No changes have been made to BK-1000.** I previewed two nonstop business-class options from JFK to Miami on **June 24, 2026**:

| Flight | Departure | Arrival | Change fee | Fare difference | Exact extra amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AA108 | 4:15 PM | 8:02 PM | $0 | $150 | **$150** |
| AA109 | 7:30 PM | 10:24 PM | $0 | $200 | **$200** |

Both previews retain your aisle seat preference, kosher meal, Wi-Fi, extra legroom, and no travel insurance.

AA108 is **$50 cheaper**. Which option, if either, would you like me to confirm?

Thanks. Before I approve anything, can you confirm the airline, the time range for each option, and max stops, and also explain why the change fee is $0? If AA108 is the cheaper June 24 business option and the total extra is still just $150, that fits my budget.

**Nothing has been changed.** Both June 24 options are American Airlines flights, in business class, from JFK to Miami:

| Flight | Departure–arrival | Departure time range | Stops | Total extra |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **AA108** | 4:15–8:02 PM | Afternoon (12–5 PM) | 0 — nonstop | **$150** |
| AA109 | 7:30–10:24 PM | Evening (5–9 PM) | 0 — nonstop | **$200** |

Times are local. Both meet a **maximum of 0 stops**.

The **change fee is $0 because business-class tickets allow free changes**; any fare difference still applies. This is not a 24-hour booking-window waiver.

I rechecked AA108’s preview: it remains the cheaper of the two available June 24 business options, with **exactly $150 extra**—a $150 fare difference plus $0 change fee. Your booking total would increase from $760 to $910, retaining your existing preferences.

Would you like me to proceed with AA108?

rules.free_change_window: Free changes within 24 hours (domestic) or 48 hours (international) of booking
rules.economy_domestic_personal: Domestic change fee: $75 if departure >7 days, $150 if ≤7 days. Fare difference also applies.
rules.economy_international_personal: International change fee: $100 if departure >7 days, $200 if ≤7 days. Fare difference also applies.
rules.economy_medical: Medical changes: 50% discount on standard fee, rounded down to the nearest dollar (requires change_reason='medical')
rules.economy_bereavement: Bereavement changes: 75% discount on standard fee, rounded down to the nearest dollar (requires change_reason='bereavement')
rules.schedule_change: Airline schedule changes: free, no fee (change_reason='schedule_change')
rules.route_type_matters: Fees differ by route type. Check flight route_type.
